---
title: "pressR trial report"
output: html_document
header-includes:
  - \usepackage{longtable}
params:
  trial: NULL
  masks: NULL
  thresholds: NULL
---

```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 7, fig.height = 5)
library(pressR)
```

```{r}
trial <- params$trial
```

## Trial

```{r}
.report_table(pr_report_info(trial))
```

## Summary

```{r}
.report_table(pr_summary_long(trial), digits=4)
```

## Maximum pressure picture

```{r, fig.alt="Maximum measured value at each sensor across the recording, arranged by sensor coordinates."}
pr_plot_heatmap(trial)
```

## Dynamics

```{r, fig.alt="Total force over time when physical calibration is available; otherwise an explicit unavailable notice."}
pr_plot_force_time(trial)
```

## Interpretation and provenance

Unavailable physical quantities are labelled explicitly. Region definitions and
reference observations must match the acquisition and analysis context.
Exploratory bridge, slip and concentration settings are not diagnostic rules.

```{r}
if (!is.null(params$thresholds)) .report_table(params$thresholds)
```
